# Animations

Entrance (`animationIn`) and exit (`animationOut`) animations for layers:

```json
{ "type": "text", "text": "Hello", "start": 0, "duration": 3,
  "animationIn": { "type": "pop", "duration": 0.35, "easing": "ease-out" },
  "animationOut": { "type": "fade" } }
```

Easing is one of `linear`, `ease-in`, `ease-out` (default) or `ease-in-out`. Text and shape layers support every animation (rendered with libass). Media layers support only the ones marked below; any other animation on a media layer falls back to a fade.

| id | Name | Media layers | Default duration | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `none` | None | yes | 0s | Appear/disappear instantly. |
| `fade` | Fade | yes | 0.4s | Opacity fade. Subtle and universally safe. |
| `slide-up` | Slide Up | yes | 0.4s | Moves up into place (enters from below). |
| `slide-down` | Slide Down | yes | 0.4s | Moves down into place (enters from above). |
| `slide-left` | Slide Left | yes | 0.4s | Moves left into place (enters from the right). |
| `slide-right` | Slide Right | yes | 0.4s | Moves right into place (enters from the left). |
| `pop` | Pop |  | 0.35s | Scales from 0 with a springy overshoot. Energetic, social-media style. |
| `zoom` | Zoom |  | 0.4s | Scales up from 50% while fading in. |
| `blur` | Blur In |  | 0.6s | Starts blurred and transparent, sharpens into focus. Cinematic. |
| `typewriter` | Typewriter |  | 1s | Reveals characters one at a time over the animation duration. |
| `spin` | Spin |  | 0.5s | Rotates into place while fading in. |
| `wipe` | Wipe |  | 0.5s | Revealed left-to-right by a moving mask. |
| `drop` | Drop |  | 0.35s | Falls from above with a fade, like a title slam. |
| `stretch` | Stretch |  | 0.4s | Expands horizontally from a thin line. |
| `grow` | Grow |  | 0.5s | Scales up from nothing (out: shrinks to nothing) around its center, without overshoot. Use with ease-in for a bubble or circle reveal that accelerates, as in branded section transitions. |
